svg.title: FIG-05
svg.text: Speed 5": one orthogonal square (1"), two diagonal squares
(1.5" each) = 4". One more orthogonal square (1") is allowed;
another diagonal (1.5") would exceed the 1" remaining.
Cost of one step into a square (2.6, 2.9.3)
Numbers are the movement spent to enter that square from the
centre square. Difficult Terrain: 2" orthogonal, 3" diagonal. If
Difficult Terrain, Climb or Jump each apply to the same 1", use
A Large combatant stepping east would occupy a Difficult
Terrain square. For each step, use the highest movement cost
that applies to any square occupied after the step: this
A diagonal step needs at least one of the 2 orthogonal
intermediate positions to be one the combatant could legally
enter. If both are closed, no diagonal step is possible.
